counterfactual_tests.X: 把 assimilation 改成 support_only；若仍判X则失败
counterfactual_tests.Z: 把 convergence 改成 distributed；若仍判Z则失败
counterfactual_tests.N: 移除 support；若仍判N则失败
counterfactual_tests.ZN: 移除 receiver response/propagation；若仍判ZN则失败
counterfactual_tests.NZ: 取消 reserved slot 或让其被他人永久占用；若仍判NZ则失败
counterfactual_tests.XN: 把 repeatable rule 改成 one-off arrangement；若仍判XN则失败
counterfactual_tests.NX: 把 repeated/cumulative yield 改成 single temporary courtesy，或立即恢复权益；若仍判NX则失败
counterfactual_tests.ZX: 把 actor-initiates 改为 actor-reacts；若仍判ZX则失败
counterfactual_tests.XZ: 把 near-threshold 改为 normal-state，或把 trigger 改成 large；若仍判XZ则失败
counterfactual_tests.XPZ: 让 audience 无法读取 presentation layer，或移除 audience response；若仍判XPZ则失败
